canaryBaseline.limitation: Observed executions, not a complete scheduled-window availability denominator. Only the latest failure was inspected here; no claim that every failure had the same cause.

liveEvalRepeatability.limitation: One diagnostic repeat passed on identical evaluated source. The first run did not retain public answer text, so an omitted topic versus unrecognized phrasing remains unproven; both reports are retained. No claim of deterministic model output.

liveEvalScorerCorrection.cause: The public answer explicitly described regulation records and country differences, but the finite topic vocabulary omitted 法规记录.

ciToolchainCompatibility.cause: pnpm/action-setup v6 self-update creates a PNPM_HOME/bin shell shim, not a direct package entry; the previous resolver looked for package.json at the wrong root.

ciWorkerObservation.failure: A Vitest worker exited unexpectedly during governed-documents integration tests; 64 cases remained uncompleted.
ciWorkerObservation.limitation: No worker exit signal or kernel evidence was retained. A passing bounded retry is not proof that the original worker failure is permanently resolved.

linuxDurableFixturePermissions.failure: The durable controller refused submission before real build; root Git archive extraction retained group-writable 0775 directories and 0664 files.
linuxDurableFixturePermissions.fix: Pin Git archive tar.umask=0022 for the synthetic CI release; preserve production trusted-path rejection.

limitations: The PR has not passed its final required CI gate or been deployed.
The original SSH 255 root cause remains unproven; durable execution removes connection dependence, not historical uncertainty.
The observed canary history includes real readiness failures; changing the connection envelope is not proof of long-term availability.
Same-disk compressed journals are recoverable but are not offsite disaster-recovery backups.
